title: Austin Welcomes New District 4 Leader
meeting_type: Austin City Council Community Interest Announcement - Swearing In Ceremony
summary:
*   **New Council Member Sworn In:** Jose Chito Vela was officially inaugurated as the new Council Member for District 4.
*   **Ceremonial Opening:** The session began with an invocation, leading into the formal oath of office for Mr. Vela.
*   **Warm Welcome from Colleagues:** Fellow Council Members and Mayor Adler offered their congratulations and support, expressing enthusiasm for his addition to the dais.
*   **Focus on Unity:** The Mayor noted that this particular gathering was primarily ceremonial, emphasizing a supportive start for the new representative without any contentious votes.
